title: Installer .github confinement
prose: Plugin install, update, explicit removal, and automatic retirement may mutate only inside the consuming repo's .github/ tree. Every payload and managed-state path is lexically confined and every existing destination/parent chain is rejected when it contains a link or reparse point before state reads, stats, journal writes, backups, deletion, or pruning. Removal authority is rederived under the mutation lock; untrusted receipts, tombstones, state, and journals never widen it. No plugin mutation may touch docs/, scripts/, schemas/, or any tree outside .github/.
description: Security boundary: untrusted plugin metadata and recovery state can never cause mutation outside .github/ or through linked parents. Enforced by confinement, link rejection, the shared mutation lock, journal validation, and registry/install/remove tests.
